context: A boss and his manager review investments
purpose: Teach: エリート/特権/指向/リターン/置き換え/手がけ/財務省/おおむね

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期のリターン、おおむね予想通りだな。
lines.en: This quarter's returns are mostly tracking as expected.
lines.style: Calm, measured opening. Slight nod in the voice. Matter-of-fact tone. The satisfaction of things proceeding on schedule without drama.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。財務省のガイドラインに沿った運用です。
lines.en: Yes. We're operating within the finance ministry guidelines.
lines.style: Formal but not stiff. Each phrase lands with quiet precision. Respectful deference to the framework without defensiveness. Brief, professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: エリート部隊の指向、品質重視で置き換えはせず。
lines.en: The team's approach — quality over rotation. No shortcuts.
lines.style: Approving nod in the phrasing. Slight weight on 「quality」. Conversational but firm. Speaking to someone who understands the stakes without needing them explained.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 特権的な権限、最小限に手がけている部署もあります。
lines.en: Some departments are also keeping special access protocols to the minimum necessary.
lines.style: Calm, informative. Practical tone. Showing additional diligence without seeking praise for it. Steady cadence, slight rise on 「also」 to signal added value.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet weight on the instruction. Not a request—a directive from someone accustomed to being followed. Finality without harshness. The voice of someone who trusts but verifies.
